Digital Input Debouncing Time
When the environmental interference is big, increasing the setting value can enhance the control stability. However, if the value is set too high, it will impact the response time.

Digital Input 1 Configuration
Selects the DI function (YX) and function of the NO or NC contact (Z). When parameters are modified, re-start the servo drive so that it can function normally.  You can configure ID268 (P3.006) to change the source for the digital signal, either through an external terminal block or communication parameter ID281 (P4.007).
See Description of Digital Input Functions in the user manual.

YX: Input function
See Description of Digital Input Functions in the user manual.
Z: Input contact NO or NC
0=normally closed (NC contact)
1=normally open (NO contact)
U: reserved

Digital Input Control Source
Each bit of this parameter determines one input source of DI signal.

Bit0…Bit9 correspond to DI1 …DI10
Bit10…Bit12 correspond to VDI11 …VDI13
0=DI status is controlled by the external hardware
1=DI status is controlled by ID281 (P4.007) DIOverride

Digital Output Override
If ID203 (P2.018) is set to 0x0130, then the output of DO#1 is the bit 0 status of ID280 (P4.006), and so forth. The DO Code (0x30…0x3F) can be set via communication DO, and then written into ID280 (P4.006).

Bit 00: Corresponds to DO code = 0x30
Bit 01: Corresponds to DO code = 0x31
Bit 02: Corresponds to DO code = 0x32
Bit 03: Corresponds to DO code = 0x33
Bit 04: Corresponds to DO code = 0x34
Bit 05: Corresponds to DO code = 0x35
Bit 06: Corresponds to DO code = 0x36
Bit 07: Corresponds to DO code = 0x37
Bit 08: Corresponds to DO code = 0x38
Bit 09: Corresponds to DO code = 0x39
Bit 10: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3A
Bit 11: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3B
Bit 12: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3C
Bit 13: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3D
Bit 14: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3E
Bit 15: Corresponds to DO code = 0x3F

Digital Input Override
The source of DI input signal can be external terminal (DI1…DI5) or software SDI1 …SDI5 (corresponding to Bit 0…4 of this parameter, which is determined by ID268 (P3.006). If the corresponding bit of P3.006
is 1, the source is software SDI [ID281 (P4.007)]; if the corresponding bit is 0, then the source is hardware DI.
Read parameters: Shows the DI status after combining external DI and software DI.
Write parameters: Writes the software SDI status.

Drive Keypad Input Status
